items.title: Eurreal Wilford "Little Brother" Montgomery Interview, 1958-05-29
items.q: The very first records I made was with singer Irene Scruggs.

ctx.x: Can you tell us about some of the records? Those old Bluebird records or the very first records you made?
The very first records I made was with singer Irene Scruggs. They called it Chocolate Brown. She was out of St. Louis. She has a daughter over in Europe called Baby Scruggs. She's a showgirl now.
That's her name. What label was that for?
